Message from Aura: To get the best result: 1. Hold the ring between your thumb and index finger and gently insert the ear tip. 2. Once you feel a gentle seal, give it a small twist toward the back of your head so it sits snugly. 3. Adjust until it’s comfortable and secure. Fit check: move your jaw side to side—if it stays put, you’ve got a good fit.
